app.title: Persona Sticker Lab
app.subtitle: Create stickers made for your Agent~
app.privacy: The persona portrait and optional cue image are sent only with this governed image task.

persona.title: Your Agent persona
persona.disabledDetail: No Agent persona is currently enabled.
persona.noPortraitDetail: The Agent persona does not have a usable portrait yet.
persona.unavailableDetail: The Agent persona cannot be read right now.
persona.requiredDetail: Create an Agent persona and generate its portrait in Myriad, then reopen this app.
persona.help: The Agent portrait always defines the generated character's identity and appearance.

composer.title: Choose an expression cue
composer.subtitle: Pick one of three modes. Each task creates one standalone PNG sticker.

mode.emojiDetail: Express an emotion with one symbol

cue.customPriority: A custom value takes priority when filled

prompt.title: Additional prompt (high priority)
prompt.priority: Takes priority for action, expression, props, framing, and emotional intensity
prompt.placeholder: For example: crouching with both hands on the head, tears spraying sideways like fountains, extremely exaggerated motion.
prompt.boundary: Optional. It cannot override the Agent identity or the fixed single-image, one-character, and no-text rules.

image.title: Upload one expression image
image.formats: PNG, JPEG, or WebP; up to 10 MiB
image.hint: It supplies only the expression, pose, and composition. The Agent persona still defines the character.

output.title: Output: standalone PNG sticker
output.detail: 1024 × 1024, one character, no text or watermark.

status.creatingDetail: The persona portrait and expression cue are being submitted through Myriad's governed Task API.
status.waiting: Task created, waiting for the image
status.waitingDetail: The client waits up to 315 seconds. You can cancel this task.
status.successDetail: One standalone PNG sticker is ready to preview in this session.

result.title: Your Agent's new expression is ready
result.cacheBoundary: The result is a temporary host PNG cache entry. View it full size or download it now.
result.downloadBoundary: Myriad reads the current cache and saves the actual PNG. Download it while the cache is still available.
result.downloadStarted: The PNG was handed to Myriad for download.

errors.provider: The image provider did not complete the task. The app will not silently discard the persona or cue image and retry as text-to-image.
errors.permission: The ai:image permission is not granted. Allow image generation in Myriad's Tapp permissions.
errors.persona: Create an Agent persona and generate a usable portrait in Myriad first.
errors.expressionCue: Choose or enter an Emoji or kaomoji.
errors.expressionImage: Expression image mode requires one uploaded reference.
errors.timeout: The client wait timed out. The app attempted to cancel the remote task.
errors.cancelled: The task was cancelled and produced no result.
errors.reference: The reference must be a PNG, JPEG, or WebP whose content matches its MIME type.
errors.referenceLimit: Choose exactly one expression reference no larger than 10 MiB after decoding.
errors.inputLimit: The prompt or task input exceeds the current AI Task limit. Shorten the custom value.
errors.apiUnavailable: Tapp.ai.tasks image generation is unavailable in this sandbox.
errors.fileApiUnavailable: The browser does not expose a usable FileReader.
errors.downloadUnavailable: This installation does not expose the host PNG download bridge. Update Myriad and try again.
errors.fileRead: The local image could not be read or the read was cancelled. Choose it again.
errors.resultInvalid: The task did not return a safe Myriad PNG image-cache path, so it cannot be previewed.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Check the error code in the Myriad console before retrying.
